status: Phase T draft, 2026-09-12; designed condition, nothing here is calibrated against behaviour
inherits: dt, w_syn, f_poi, duration, n_trials, seed rule, connectivity and completeness files, GRN cell sets (data/cells.json) and the MN9 readout come from base_protocol unchanged

brake_channel.name: brake
brake_channel.mechanism: same as the GRN channels: PoissonInput per cell, N=1, weight=w_syn*f_poi, refractory of driven cells set to 0 while driven (model.py rule via SimNet.set_rates)
brake_channel.drive_note: 100 Hz is Tastekin et al. 2026 Fig S17's level for GNG015; their choice, uncalibrated; ours is too. 0 Hz is the reproducibility check against the frozen grid's sugar-only column (bitter, water, ir94e all 0 Hz).

buddy.source: docs/tonic_candidates.md rows 4, 5, 14, 15 (all four CB0806 cells, two per side)

cb0465.source: docs/tonic_candidates.md row 1 (right cell only; the strongest single inhibitory input to left MN9)

taste.sugar_levels: all five sugar levels of data/grid_levels.json (none 0, low 60, medium 80, high 120, very_high 200 Hz)

trial.seed_rule: seed = base_seed + trial + 1000 * global_index, global_index = position in (brake, drive, sugar) product order (seed scheme v2, as the grid); results are statistically, not spike-for-spike, comparable with the grid because the stimulus PoissonGroup gains the brake units

readouts: left and right MN9 rate (base readout)
mean rate of the brake cells (spikes of the brake ids / n cells / duration)
latency to the first left-MN9 spike (ms; per trial, summarised as median over trials with a spike, and the count of silent trials)
rate of the frozen sugar GRN set (sanity: it should follow the sugar drive and not the brake)

replays.conditions: per brake: drive 100 Hz with sugar high, and drive 100 Hz with sugar none
replays.format: one extra whole-network trial per condition saved as results/tonic/replays/<cond_id>.npz in the grid replay layout (flywire_id, t_ms, seed, rates); not packed, not shipped
replays.seed_rule: base_seed + 700000 + 100000 + global_index (disjoint from grid and grid-replay seeds)
